_comment: GAME_PLAN 18.3 (today, tag REAL) and 18.4 (planned/proposed). Model params approximate, [verify]. kind: GROUND_OPTICAL needs V <= vLim and eps >= epsMin with chance pCover per night; SPACE_IR needs D >= dRef * (r delta) / rDeltaRef with eps in [epsMin, epsMax]; RADAR tracks only. observer: HOME (ground, L1, lunar), INNER (Venus-like orbit), L4 / L5 (HOME +/- 60 deg). since: year the network began (planned ones get their year when a program completes); the game's now is EPOCH_YEAR (2026).

networks.name: CATALINA SKY SURVEY
networks.note: Arizona, 1.5 m + 0.7 m; historically the largest share of NEO discoveries

networks.name: PAN-STARRS 1+2
networks.note: Haleakala, two 1.8 m; deep, northern sky

networks.name: ATLAS (4 UNITS)
networks.note: whole sky nightly; the last-days warning system; found 2024 YR4

networks.name: ZTF
networks.note: Palomar 1.2 m Schmidt; fast cadence

networks.name: RUBIN OBSERVATORY / LSST
networks.note: Cerro Pachon 8.4 m; survey under way in 2026; ~6x the sensitivity of existing surveys

networks.name: ESA FLYEYE #1
networks.note: 1 m compound-eye optic; first light 2025

networks.name: CNEOST
networks.note: Xuyi, China, 1.04 m Schmidt

networks.name: GOLDSTONE + GREEN BANK RADAR
networks.note: tracking and shape; Arecibo lost in 2020

networks.name: CHINA COMPOUND-EYE RADAR
networks.note: Chongqing phased array, under construction

networks.name: MPC / CNEOS / NEOCC / IAWN / SMPAG
networks.note: reduces false alarms; the INTERNATIONAL COORDINATION program

networks.name: AIRBURST SENSING
networks.note: GOES lightning mappers, CTBTO infrasound, fireball networks; post-hoc only

networks.name: NEO SURVEYOR (L1 IR)
networks.note: 50 cm IR at Sun-Earth L1, launch planned 2027; built, awaiting launch

networks.name: NEOMIR (SUNWARD RING)
networks.note: ESA study: 20 m objects with at least 3 weeks warning

networks.name: FLYEYE NETWORK (4 SITES)
networks.note: four Flyeye sites across both hemispheres

networks.name: RUBIN TWILIGHT SURVEY
networks.note: twilight observations of the interior (Atira) region

networks.name: RADAR NET
networks.note: second 70 m class dish + phased array

networks.name: CNSA SPACE IR SURVEY
networks.note: second IR surveyor

networks.name: L4 / L5 SENTINELS
networks.note: twin telescopes at Earth-Sun L4/L5 for parallax and interior coverage

networks.name: VENUS-ORBIT IR SURVEY
networks.note: sees interior-orbit threats

networks.name: LUNAR FARSIDE STATION
networks.note: survey telescopes on the lunar far side; no weather

networks.name: RADAR CONSTELLATION
networks.note: space-based radar at high orbit

networks.name: INTERSTELLAR WATCH
networks.note: wide-field survey tuned for hyperbolic visitors; enables the interstellar round type

networks.name: HIVE SURVEY 1 (16 VISIBLE CUBESATS)
networks.note: feasibility study HIVE_1: stacked small telescopes near the Earth's orbit, no daylight or weather

networks.name: HIVE SURVEY 2 (64 NODES)
networks.note: feasibility study HIVE_2: all-sky every few days, parallax on the first night

networks.name: HIVE SURVEY 3 (INFRARED, VENUS AND L4/L5 LEGS)
networks.note: feasibility study HIVE_3: albedo-blind, looks outward from inside the Earth's orbit
